spans.text: AKSHAY PATNI
SENIOR ASSOCIATE – FUND ADMINISTRATION | MIDDLE OFFICE | TRADE SUPPORT
+91- Alter Phone no.: 7597883905| akshaypatni2026@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/akshaypatni-55549516b
SUMMARY
Finance professional with 3+ years of experience across investment operations, middle office, and
derivatives trade support at global banks and fund administrators. Strong expertise in OTC derivatives,
prime brokerage, NAV support, T+1 settlements, and end-to-end trade lifecycle management. Proven
ability to analyze and resolve complex trade, cash, and position breaks, reduce operational risk, and
drive automation-led efficiency improvements. Actively upskilling in Python, SQL, and Power BI to
transition into data-driven investment operations and risk analytics roles.
CORE SKILLS
& Middle Office & Fund Ops: Trade booking & validation, affirmation, lifecycle events, NAV support, pricing checks, cash &
position reconciliation, break investigation, corporate actions, exception management, settlement processing, SLA
adherence, operational risk controls
& Products: TRS, IRS, CDS, Equity Swaps, Bonds, Repos, Equities
& Tools: Triana, MarkitWire, IceLink, MS Excel (Pivot, VLOOKUP), Python (basic automation), SQL (basic), Power BI (basic)
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Associate – Fund Administration NAV Fund Administration, Jaipur | Dec 2024 – Present
& Managed portfolio services for hedge fund clients, including trade mapping, cash flow identification, pricing validation, and
daily cash & position reconciliations.
& Verified OTC and fixed-income valuations (coupons, accruals, interest, independent price sources) and supported NAV
production through position checks, exception handling, and break investigation.
& Resolved trade, cash, and position breaks to ensure accurate T+1 reporting across weekly, bi-monthly, and monthly cycles.
Implemented automation of manual fund processing activities, achieving 30–50% reduction in processing time, and
ensured accurate cash processing and reconciliation between internal books and bank statements.
& Managed end-to-end Fund Administration activities for Hedge Fund clients including trade processing, cash & position
reconciliation, pricing validation, and NAV support.
& Performed trade enrichment, trade mapping, and pre-processing validation for OTC and Fixed Income securities prior to NAV
production.
& Executed daily trade processing, cash flow identification, pricing verification, and exception management across multiple
portfolios.
& Performed cash, position and trade reconciliations, investigated breaks, completed root cause analysis, and ensured timely
resolution within SLA.
& Supported trade lifecycle management from trade capture through reconciliation, settlement support, and reporting.
& Performed pre-upload validation of trade and pricing data before fund accounting processing.
& Processed bulk trade uploads and validated portfolio data to ensure accurate downstream processing.
& Supported NAV validation, pricing checks, accrual verification, and exception handling for hedge fund portfolios.
& Automated manual fund administration processes using Python, reducing processing time by 30–50%.
Senior Analyst – Trade Support s Prime Brokerage BNP Paribas ISPL, Mumbai | May 2024 – Dec 2024
& Validated and booked swaps and exotic derivatives across SPB and Delta One desks, ensuring alignment with term sheets and
broker feeds.
& Managed trade lifecycle events including amendments, corporate actions, and option assignments.
& Resolved delta and economic breaks between swap and hedge legs, working with SPB and Delta One trading desks to mitigate
operational and market risk.
& Supported the US T+1 settlement transition, contributing to process and control enhancements.
& Executed trade capture, trade validation, and booking of OTC derivatives across Prime Brokerage and Delta One desks.
& Managed complete trade lifecycle events including amendments, novations, corporate actions, option assignments, resets, and
terminations.
& Performed trade enrichment, ensuring trade attributes matched term sheets and broker confirmations.
& Conducted STP break investigation, resolving trade, cash, and economic breaks through root cause analysis.
& Supported T+1 settlement initiatives and coordinated with Front Office, Operations, and Technology teams to improve STP
efficiency.
& Performed pre-upload validation of trade data before booking into downstream systems.
& Supported bulk trade processing for high-volume OTC transactions.
Analyst – HFS OTC Northern Trust, Pune | Mar 2022 – Dec 2023
& Executed trade affirmation and reconciliation for TRS, IRS, and CDS, including resets and unwinds, using
Triana, MarkitWire, and IceLink to resolve breaks efficiently.
& Automated broker processing workflows, delivering operational efficiency equivalent to 0.3 FTE savings.
& Recognized by onshore stakeholders for accuracy, responsiveness, and operational excellence.
& Executed OTC derivative trade affirmation, trade confirmation, and reconciliation for TRS, IRS, and CDS products. Performed
trade enrichment, validation, and lifecycle management using Triana, MarkitWire, and IceLink.
Investigated STP exceptions, trade breaks, cash breaks, and position breaks while coordinating with counterparties for timely
resolution.
& Managed trade confirmations, resets, unwinds, and lifecycle events for OTC derivative products.
& Performed bulk trade uploads and validation activities to support high-volume OTC processing.
& Validated trade economics and pricing prior to downstream processing and reconciliation.
& Automated broker processing workflows, reducing manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.
EDUCATION
BBA (Finance s Marketing)
Ahmedabad University, 2021
